screen.title: Fix only the typo
screen.body:
1. Ask: Fix only the typo. Change nothing else.
2. Google Docs: File > Version history > Name current version. Paste the reply.
3. File > Version history > See version history. Tick Show changes.
4. Undo anything you didn't ask for.
